record.reason: Squeezer is a serving framework that holistically schedules multiple DNN models for edge video analytics on a single GPU, decoupling cross-model scheduling into balanced operator grouping and model-level scheduling; it is genuine inference serving/scheduling, but for vision DNN pipelines rather than LLMs.
record.title: Squeezer: Efficient Multi-DNN Inference for Edge Video Analytics via Cross-Model Scheduling
